rounds.text: Readymix Construction Machinery Ltd faces significant operational instability, evidenced by a negative cash conversion ratio of -1.86x and a substantial negative operating cash flow of Rs -13 Cr as of March 2026 [E28, E29]. This liquidity strain is compounded by a sharp increase in borrowings, which nearly doubled from Rs 17 Cr to Rs 32 Cr in just one year [E32]. The company’s profitability is highly volatile, with trailing twelve-month profit growth plummeting by -36% and operating margins showing an inconsistent trend over the last three years [E19, E26]. Institutional confidence has evaporated, as evidenced by the complete exit of foreign institutions and a significant reduction in domestic holdings, resulting in a negative money flow signal [E35, E36, E37]. Furthermore, the company’s inability to convert sales into cash is highlighted by high debtors of 174 days, and it fails to return any capital to shareholders through dividends [E46, E47]. Conceded: the company has delivered strong historical profit growth of 58.8% CAGR over five years and currently trades at a significant discount to its book value [E44, E45].
